Kota, trapped in a confined space, watches her friend Alam dance freely in nature. Alam’s graceful movements reflect the harmony with the environment. In contrast, Kota’s dance is a desperate response to her restrictive surroundings, mirroring her mother’s struggles. As Alam extends a hand of friendship, Kota gradually breaks free from her confinement, learning to embrace the natural world and dance harmoniously with her friend.
An overworked career mom who tries to get home early for her daughter’s birthday ends up taking care of her boss’ daughter all night and missing the whole birthday.

Sinta wants to continue the legendary noodle shop her recently deceased adoptive father owned. Still, the biological child of her adoptive father comes from out of town and intends to sell the house and the noodle shop.

A rising young photo model named Weda finds her career on the brink of collapse due to a scandal involving her boyfriend, Bagas. In a desperate attempt to find a way out, Bagas takes Weda to his hometown—Rangkaspuna Village, a remote and isolated place once used as a dumping ground for unidentified corpses. The village still clings to dark mystical practices led by a shaman named Ni Itoh and her loyal servant, Rini. However, their initial intention to save Weda’s future quickly turns into a nightmare.

Tells the story of Ritwan, a foster child who wants to make his dreams come true. However, he faced a dilemma when he had to be respectful to his adoptive parents to meet their expectations for participation in the Harvest.

Jaraknya (The Lost Dream) tells the story of a boy named Ali who lives in a village across the river, where the only way for him to get to school is by crossing the Kapuas River. Ali dreams of pursuing an education to the highest level so he can build a bridge in his village. However, difficult economic conditions and a lack of support from those around him make Ali think twice about pursuing his dream.
Ambar and Reni are beginner makeup artists whose limited knowledge of beauty culture forces them to face a group of mothers.
A wealthy young man falls in love with a café singer, but his disapproving mother schemes to separate them and forces the pregnant woman to terminate her pregnancy to protect the family's reputation.
tells the story of a nuclear explosion that attacks the earth which will focus on three brothers who flee to the forest to take shelter from the boom boom attacks out there.

Gina and Gani's lives changed drastically when they discovered their son Agni drew his energy from unknown sources. As fear spread, they uncovered the truth: Agni was no ordinary child—he was the Child of Damnation.

Dina, a student who dreams of becoming a doctor, works at a boarding school as a nurse in the clinic and takes care of the students there. But, after one of the ustadz died, all sorts of bad things happened and scary events befell the students during the tahajud prayer.

Sometimes, parents are too strict in raising their children. Risa, a girl who is still in elementary school often gets bad treatment from her father. Like being scolded a lot, even physically hurt. Until one day something bad happened to Risa that caused her father to regret what he did to Risa.

Ira lives with her mother, Linda. One day, without any rational explanation, a mystical incident causes Linda to behave like a madwoman—suffering physically and frequently hallucinating. Unable to cope with her mother's condition, Ira asks her siblings, Ara and Ari, to come home and help take care of their mother. Unfortunately, fate has other plans, and Linda eventually passes away.

Elang, a football player for the Indonesia Football National Team, is forced to fight on the streets to pay for medical expenses for his mother who suffers from Alzheimer's. Elang's decision to leave the Indonesia Football National Team and join Sidney Warriors Football Club for the sake of money, disappointed his mother and Laras, his sister. When he returned to Indonesia, Elang faced threats from Hardiman who took his mother hostage and forced his team to lose. In a big dilemma, will Elang choose the honor of the his nation or his mother's life?
The relationship between native women in the cities of Cianjur, Bogor, and male tourists from the Middle East, that merges beliefs and morals.
An independent photographer then meets his old friend as a client. Between their meetings, conversations arise and feelings are expressed.

Other than her hugely popular shows at one of Bali’s favourite gay bars, life isn’t exactly going to plan for trans performer Bulan. After meeting aspiring filmmaker Lily, however, Bulan starts to address her pain and anger. The result is both shocking and cathartic.

Depicting the dynamics of a location that conventionally connects two points that are often crowded with people. Through the action of commotion, intimate conversations, and meeting new people, all of which are captured from one point of view and rolling without cuts.
When a gifted chef loses his sharp sense of taste, he turns to an old friend who helps him rediscover traditional flavors through an old recipe book.

Four teenagers who renovate the house of Mba Darti, the daughter of Nyai Melati, a famous traditional singer (sinden). They experience strange events related to the death of Nyai Melati, who was murdered due to rivalry with another sinden, Fahma. The cremated ashes of Fahma are used by Kliman, a former foreman, to drive the teenagers away with the help of Ki Renggo, a paranormal expert. The spirit of Fahma possesses Darti and attacks them, but the terror is eventually stopped when Ki Renggo burns Fahma’s ashes, ending the haunting.

Jaya is a greedy man who was cursed to become a genie. He was trapped for 59 years in a kendi until someone finally let him out, but unfortunately because of the shock, his prospective master fell unconscious, so he had to wait for his master to wake up to remove the curse.
A group of teenagers, three cleaning staff, and a young married couple confront a social contract when they meet in the elevator queue of a middle-class apartment building.
Short on cash, food analyst Sari makes a deal to go on a blind date, only to realize she's been set up with Utama, her hateable but handsome boss.
The Boys who's try to revenge from what happened to them when they were kidnapped by the village leader who wanted to take away their freedom.
As Ratna, a filmmaker, approaches her wedding day, she learns what it's like to be a model housewife.

Yohanes’ life hangs by a thread as financial hardship leaves him unable to afford the medication for his heart condition. In his despair, he returns to the Field of Grace Church (Gereja Ladang Kasih), seeking healing and renewed hope. However, instead of solace, Yohanes discovers that the cure he longs for comes at a steep price. As his health continues to decline, he is faced with demands for sacrifices far beyond what he ever imagined.
The film depicts a group of children playing in a swimming pool in Aceh, Indonesia, working through their fear of water following the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami.

A film editor who must save his film crew from a mysterious cult by following the group's conditions, namely completing their own filmmaking. But he did not know that the cult he was facing was a terrifying cult that he could not trust.

An orphan named ANDI (10) is always under pressure in his environment. Every day he always looks battered because he fights with his rival RIVAL (11) at school. Likewise, when at home, ANDI is always scolded and beaten by his FATHER (35). All this made Andi miss and long to be with his late mother. One day his mother came but took the form of a pocong. Does Andi accept the condition of his mother who is in the form of a pocong?

Marta, Imam and Kartini received punishment from the teacher, which was to buy 2B pencils. Unfortunately, they made a new mistake. Although initially they ran away, but finally they dared to be responsible!

To reconcile after a final divorce, a former couple must navigate a legally required interim marriage, leading to unexpected jealousy and drama when the ex-husband repeatedly interferes in her new relationship.
A talented 12-year-old boy dream of becoming a great soccer player despite his loving grandfather's stern disapproval.
In the chaotic aftermath following the collapse of Indonesia’s dictatorship, a team of researchers discovers a forgotten archive revealing a covert operation that manipulated dreams and memories.
The youngest child, torn between family expectations and her existing relationship, faces an unexpected arranged marriage on the day of her father's death.

Kaldera never got along with her biological father, before her marriage to the love of her life, she was forced to travel with his father. Kaldera is now expressing her disappointment, as well as getting answers about what happened to her father all this time.

Sadewa was shocked by his ex-girlfriend who suddenly returned and brought a child named Keshia. Keshia's arrival made Sadewa realize that his life would be destroyed and in disarray, until an accident changed everything.

Hasya, a vocational high school graduate who is ambitious about her dreams. In the midst of her shortcomings, it is not an obstacle to pursuing her dreams. Being paralyzed and disabled is a challenge for her, to be able to continue pursuing her dreams. Ups and downs are no longer new, they have become food for her.

A family consisting of father, mother and two children, namely Rita and Ridho. In the evening, their parents went to an event, while Rita and Ridho stayed at home. While their parents were away, Rita felt bored and did various activities such as playing games and watching streaming. While Rita was busy watching, suddenly a buzzer woke her up, and when she returned to the sofa to continue watching, she realized that her cell phone had disappeared. That's where strange things started to happen.
Two people who meet each other while living in the same boarding house and get to know each other, end up being trapped in the boarding house bathroom and start sharing stories with one another.

Raka, a court security officer, and his pregnant wife, Nina, celebrate her success in passing the bar exam. But their joyous celebration is shattered when Nina is found brutally murdered. As the trial spirals towards an unjust outcome, Raka resolves to overturn the corrupt verdict and seek justice for his late wife.

Alina, a popular Instagram celebrity, is facing various challenges in her life. The death of her best friend further depresses her. Her encounter with Omar, a final-semester student, rekindles her hope for love. Omar also encourages her to become a better person. However, just as her life's direction begins to change, Alina loses her "migration" direction.

Following the daily lives of Mr. Yadi and Mrs. Ami, a blind couple who work as massage therapists who work in Malioboro, Yogyakarta. In his daily life, reflecting love and togetherness is a strong foundation in living life. Despite being faced with various obstacles from family and work background. Mr. Yadi and Mrs. Ami survive because of mutual love and strength, but are determined to remain enthusiastic about working for their family. The ending suggests that the two of them love each other because their happiness comes from togetherness and loyalty.

Siti Anantri (49) is an abusive mother who wants to make amends for her past mistakes. However, her child is in critical condition. She must express her apologies before her child dies. Will she succeed in gaining forgiveness?
Tells the story of a small child Tatan (8) who was faced with various choices when he found 2000 rupiah in cash

Being able to make peace with a painful situation is not an easy thing. Dion’s (35) days are still filled with beautiful memories with Dara (28) that are hard for him to forget. Should Dion continue to dissolve in sorrow? Or trying to adapt to change?
Amara (17), a girl neglected by her father, develops a relationship with the guidance counselor at her school.
A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.
Arini and her family went to a small town to start a new life, but it turns into a disaster after they find an ancient mirror in a secret warehouse.

Lisna, a girl in the story set in an orphan who feels lonely after graduating from vocational school, goes to Jakarta to meet Hani, her only sister who has been separated from her for a long time.  On the way she finds a strange occurrence: a possessed girl and her mysterious mother, seeing an old Chinese man who is a hit-and-run victim, who is lying on the side of the road and his eyes are almost out, until before arriving at the apartment where Hani lives, Lisna hears the story of a suicide who jumped from the 9th floor of the apartment.  By all means, Hani tries to get Vivi out of her apartment before her sister comes. Hani's departure turns out to take a long time. Lisna, who was waiting in the apartment, felt hungry and ate Vivi's leftover mushroom eggs. After eating the mushroom, Lisna experienced a strange and scary incident. Hallucination?

In the story "Baju Kurung," Nizam decides to leave his family to find work in the city. Despite his mother and younger brother living in hardship, Nizam believes his departure can change their family's fate. Meanwhile, Azmi, Nizam's younger brother, tries to take on the family's responsibilities. However, an unexpected tragic accident changes everything.

After her husband's mysterious death, Lastini believes a dark entity is possessing her daughter, Arum. With only five days before Arum's leap-year birthday, Lastini and her two other children journey across Java to seek help from spiritual healers. As the demon's grip tightens, they race against time to save Arum and find their way back home.
A short film by Tia Liztiawati

A student named Rafel who has problems at school. He is always scolded by the teacher and has no friends. Until finally, there is one person who is willing to extend his hand to Rafel. What actually happened to Rafel?

A performance adapted from a drama script by W.S Rendra. In a village, there lived a group of Naga tribe members. They lived from natural resources. However, on the other hand, there was a threat from the Astinam Kingdom who wanted to seize their territory. Can the Naga tribe fight back?

This drama performance was adapted from the poetry of Sultan Abdul Muluk. Sultan Abdul Muluk or better known as Dul Muluk was the leader of the Barbari Kingdom. One time, there was an attack from another kingdom on the Barbari Kingdom. Can Dul Muluk defend his throne and kingdom?
A girl is followed by a ghost because she walks alone at night

The life of Fajar, a high school teenager who is afraid of being left behind by current trends. Doing a live broadcast to get donations to get the items he wants by following the orders of an unknown account which leads him to regret.

A nineties documentary, investigating the tradition behind the ritual of Rampogan Siluman Macan, celebrated in Tanah Runcuk since the colonial era, that never saw the light of day due to censorship. Now, The Centre for Tanah Runcuk Studies has remade this lost film, using the original interviews as its point of departure. Four short stories told by different informants shed light on the obscured history of this ritual from a variety of perspectives.

Yura grew up in a strong Javanese family and sought spiritual growth as she matured. After marrying Andy, darkness emerged in their home due to his sins, turning her life into a small hell. Holding onto the belief that a wife must always obey her husband, can Yura still achieve Samawa while his sins remain unforgiven?
A guy who had just returned from work was called by his friend who intended to commit suicide.

Putri, 17 and seven months pregnant, feels suffocated by societal expectations on her wedding day. Overwhelmed by a bleak future, she escapes in her wedding dress and jumps into the back of a catering truck driven by Rizqy, a gay man also trapped in an arranged marriage. Their spontaneous journey is filled with humor, tension, and moments of genuine human connection. Both begin to question the life choices and paths forced upon them. SAH. is a powerful exploration of the collision between tradition and individual freedom, challenging deep-rooted norms about love, identity, and the right to define one's destiny.

After moving into her family's abandoned house, horror comic artist Ilmira struggles to complete her latest work while battling financial hardship. But when eerie figures from her past stories come to life—especially the haunting Hooded Woman—her reality spirals into a nightmare, forcing her to confront a buried childhood trauma.
The village community’s democratic maturity is put to the test during the election of a new village head.

The film tells the story of Kirman, a political prisoner exiled to Buru Island in the late 1960s. After years of trauma, he returns to his village, where he reconnects with his childhood friend, Warno. As Kirman struggles to move on from his painful past, he learns that letting go—especially of his lost love—is the key to healing and rebuilding his life.
Adit has seen things he shouldn't have and heard things he never should. He wonders—how is he still alive? Perhaps it's a question about the universe itself.

A long time ago, there lived a benevolent giantess named Mbok Moerija, who appeared as a mountain when asleep. It's said that Mbok Moerija has shed a single tear which became the source of the Spring of Life which can cure all kinds of diseases in the world. However, the spring was hidden from humans, and Mbok Moerija lay asleep for centuries. After hearing the legend of Mount Moerija, two friends decided to go looking for this mysterious spring: Dewi, full of confidence and always enthusiastically with her trusty camera to immortalize the elusive legend they are searching for, while Kayla doesn't believe in folklore, let alone fantasies about giants and water magic. However, when an argument and the mysterious movement of the mountain separate the two, they muster the courage to heal their wounds and wound friendship.
A group of friends playing truth or dare in the night, one of them doing something prohibited.

Eros, a renowned business motivator, leads a brilliant career despite his lonely personal life. One day, he gets the chance to try an Artificial Intelligence machine coded A.G.N.E.S., which promises to perform any task given to it.  Eros makes a request to A.G.N.E.S., something that should be impossible to fulfill. Will A.G.N.E.S. be able to make it happen?

A father who is still trapped in feelings from the past, makes him forbid his daughter who wants to have a career like his wife, through an offer from his wife's old producer. His decision to reveal what he felt was a new beginning for them.
When Naomi died, her Muslim father and Buddhist mother fought over her body, which made the burial process complicated.

Since birth, Maryam's life has never been free from terror and the shadow of a genie. Until finally she received a mysterious letter that always appeared in front of her, the letter always appeared even though it had been thrown away, torn apart, even burned. She knew there was something invisible following her. The figure promised her not to leave her, clinging to her every step, whispering in a voice only she could hear. The more Maryam tried to run, the stronger the bonds held her back. Until slowly, she wasn't sure anymore... was she still living as herself, or did she belong to that figure forever?
A teacher who loves his students in the wrong way
A young man did something forbidden by whistling at night.

Lena and her brother, Benhur, moved from Jakarta to Malang for college and stayed in a cozy boarding house owned by Mrs. Astri and Mr. Wiryo. Every week, all tenants gathered for a communal dinner. However, the peace turned into terror when a tenant had a strange dream and claimed the house was haunted, even seeing a hanging pocong. At first, no one believed it—until Lena saw it herself. This was no ordinary boarding house. The price to stay wasn’t money, but lives.
The lights went out, then came back on. Laughter echoed throughout the house. Dinda kept running to avoid it, but couldn't.
A girl is haunted by a ghost because she carried out a forbidden activity, namely sweeping at night.

This short film focuses on the Bajo of Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia, highlighting their strong bond with the sea and the challenges small-scale fishing communities face. Impacted by overfishing, pollution, and biodiversity loss, they are struggling to survive.

After six months of marriage, Andin begins to notice many oddities in her marriage. From the beginning, Uncle Bagyo suspected the marriage was rushed, and together with Amara—Andin's younger sister who also inherited the mystical arts—he often noticed disturbing, odd signs.  Their suspicions were proven correct when it was revealed that Ario, Andin's husband, had been having a special relationship with Naura, a wealthy woman in their town who was trying to steal Ario completely from Andin using the Lintrik love spell, a dangerous mystical power that dragged Andin and her family into endless supernatural terror. What will happen to Andin and Ario's marriage going forward?
A short film by Dinda M. Djunanda
a short film by Milaty Ismail
a short film by Ella Angel

Alie, the youngest and only daughter among five siblings, suffers relentless abuse from her father and siblings—blamed for their mother's death—when all she longs for is a bit of compassion and acceptance from her family.

On the last day. A man in a robe comes to a field with two masked men accompanying him. Meanwhile, 5 masked female dancers in the field are curious about the man in the robe. And consider him as a savior.
Someone in your circle of friends is a psychopathic killer who has a damaged mental illness and decides to take out his anger and frustration on his own friends.
Since Mom left, Dad has often scolded Tasya over trivial matters. Tasya got fed up and decided to live with her mother, leaving Dad with all his regrets.

A transfer student named DEWI (17) who has a beautiful face becomes the target of boys at her new school. This makes ANGGI (17), SANTI (16), and RINA (17) feel jealous. The three friends decide to prank DEWI by locking her in the school’s haunted bathroom.
Gito, a student in Surabaya, receives a call to come home from his father in Yogyakarta. His father dreamt that God commanded him to sacrifice his son.

Rafi is one of the thousands of victims affected by the Lapindo Mudflow eruption on May 29, 2006, in the Porong area, Sidoarjo, East Java. Rafi's family's economic condition is not good. His father has passed away, leaving his mother as the sole breadwinner. This situation is worsened by his mother's asthma, which often flares up and worsens due to the poor air quality around the mud eruption. For the sake of his mother's health, Rafi must ride his bike far out of his village to get medicine from the pharmacy, accompanied by his two closest friends. The bitter reality must eventually be accepted by Rafi, as one by one, they leave him.
A lingering ideological conversation. A discussion with two punkers during a journey on the commuter train.
A part of Massroom Project
Two children from the mountains talking about the city.

The film addresses the exile of approximately 12,000 alleged sympathizers and members of the Indonesian Communist Party, who were sent to Buru Island. The story follows Hersri as he returns to Savanajaya Village, where he lived during his exile. Sanleko Beach, the site where the first political prisoners landed, becomes the place where he recounts these bitter memories to his son, Ken. With no historical landmarks as evidence and his fading memories, Hersri struggles to preserve the painful past.

More than 40 years on, the ex-survivors revisited prison camp in Plantungan, Central Java. A place they were isolated because they were and assumed as members of Indonesian Communist Party (PKI) in a New Order era. They told a story about their suffering in silence, memories about loss, unspeakable trauma and human consciousness to remember the violence in a different period.

Joko is diagnosed with a rare and contagious disease by his doctor, which forces him to be isolated from people and his surroundings. His close friend, Joni, feels the sorrow Joko is experiencing and decides to cheer him up in his own way.
The story of a scavenger who once attended school.
A story of a Japanese soldier in times of the Japanese defeat in World War II who tries to accomplish the promise of his country: Asias independence from the West

During the era of President Soekarno, several students were selected to study abroad, including Awal Uzhara, Sjumandjaja, Ami Priono, and Zubair Lelo. They were sent to Russia to study cinematography at VGIK (The Gerasimov Institute of Cinematography). Sjumandjaja and Ami Priono went on to become famous directors in Indonesia, but Awal Uzhara never had the same fortune. After completing his Master's degree in Moscow around 1965, political instability in Indonesia arose. The country's background, where Awal had studied, became associated with a negative stigma about communism, which was linked to him.

Little Intan was used as collateral for a debt by her mother, who was forced to become a migrant worker and leave her behind. But from that moment, her life took a turn. Dedi, the debt collector — a stranger who initially just came to collect — ended up becoming an important figure in Intan’s life. Together with Tatang, they grew into an unusual kind of “family.”

Tells the story of a husband and father named Gunawan who already has a stable life by becoming a shareholder in a company he founded with his uncle, but the pressure and problems in the company make him want to leave the company, but worries continue to make Gunawan doubt whether he is able to make his family happy or on the contrary he makes his family suffer in poverty. Until something unexpected hits Gunawan's life, Gunawan must go through a life process that makes him almost reluctant to continue living, so how does Gunawan rise and make his family happy?
This story shows how emotional stress can push teens to make bad decisions, often due to fear of losing or being abandoned by their partners.

A story of high school friendship colored with ego, love and ambition. Starring Yoeriche Endine, Regina Kandou, Cindy Thefannie and Bella Verena. What do you think will happen when friendship is based on their story?

When her medical school scholarship was at risk of being revoked, Alin, who had been living away from home, was forced to return. After coming back, Alin’s perspective began to shift. She realized for the first time that her mother had been living in hardship, while her father was rarely around. Her younger sibling and older sibling also had to bear heavy burdens for the family, even sacrificing themselves and their dreams. While at home, Alin accidentally discovered her mother’s diary. Its pages were filled with memories from her mother’s youth, including her first love. This made Alin wonder: if her mother hadn’t married her father, would she have lived a happier life?
A short film by Stanislaus Daryl
A short film by Ndik Pradhono

The caregiver who usually accompanies her mother, is returning to her hometown. Fitri (Dinda Suci Lestari) has to share her time, from her busy schedule as a journalist, and also has to take care of her mother (Nelita Septiana) who is sick, she has to face all of that alone, with all her problems.
A short film by Yosafat Ocha
A short film by Caka Trisna Hartono
A short film by Lina Nur Aisyah
Because of Rini's spell, Edi left his wife and two children. As a daughter who lost her father, Vita tried to win back her father's love and bring him back into the arms of his family.
Give a "lift" is a cheating in a race. However, the kids really want the prize, and then "lift" became a way out.

The life of a family in the village of Srunen, Sleman, on the slopes of Mount Merapi—captured briefly before and after the eruption. This film becomes a record of how people move through tragedy and rebuild their lives alongside a nature that continually renews itself.

Rahmat, high school graduates but he unable to continue his studies at college because he has no money. Since the age of seven she orphaned and raised by the Mba Bunga aka Mas Bambang Mawar salon owner. Although living with a sissy but Rahmat grow into a real man, smart, pious and dutiful. Mawar saloon is infront of Ratih house, a young widow who is two years left by her husband death. Rahmat Secretly fall in love with Ratih. Yet another widow who lived in the area, Mpok Sari, has crush with Rahmat. She even always sent food to the Mawar salon and tells to every body that she is Rahmat’s wife, but Rahmat always politely declined her. So much jealous, mpok Sari says bad things about Ratih so people will hate her. Ratih tried to deny any bad news about her yet she has no the strength to defend herself.

The story begins with a brief meeting between Asep (Andika Pratama) and Farah (Donita). Asep which is the youth of the village Endah Pisan plain fell in love at first sight when I saw Farah, who is a model of Jakarta. But the arrival of the crew photographer Farah had received protesting villagers, fortunately Asep from prominent families in his village was finally able to save Farah and his friends from the wrath of villagers. The delegation was finally brought to his home Asep. Asep previously refused an arranged marriage by her mother (Lydia Kandou) with a girl from his village finally determined to pursue direct Farah to return to Jakarta. Asep also ran away from home to go to Jakarta. From this story and a funny incident that could make you laugh presented
A woman with a dark past dedicates herself to taking care of multi-handicapped children. When a young musician comes into her life, she is forced to face her history, or it will destroy her future.
When Syahdu divorces her abusive husband, she decides to marry her married ex-boyfriend, Ifand who is unable to have a child with his wife, Sofia.

"Gin Swa" (A Gift for My Father) tells the story of Alin, a 22-year-old who saves up to buy a car for his aging father, a dedicated Gin Swa craftsman who continues working despite his declining health. When tragedy strikes, Alin is forced to let go of that dream—only to discover that the traditional craft becomes his way of reconnecting with the love he shared with his late father.

From drama, comedy, to horror, every genre has become a space for expressions of love for film, fashion and photography artists. Three short films in three different genres that show the character and characteristics of their respective aesthetic views, are a form of respect for various styles of storytelling from different perspectives.
director: Nicoline Patricia Malina, Raditya Bramantya, Shadtoto Prasetio

overview: This film is dedicated to the victims of human rights violations from 1965 to 1998. It tells the story of victims uniting in solidarity and demanding that the state take responsibility in restoring justice for them.

Kodri, a young member of the people's movement, was arrested and exiled to Buru Island without trial. After his release, he still found no peace, haunted by nightmares and a life under constant surveillance. Eventually, Kodri married Sri, the younger sister of a fellow political prisoner.

Dika, a thoughtful young man in his twenties, is overwhelmed by panic when he realizes that he is trapped in the middle of a crowd. Things that once seemed ordinary have now turned into frightening threats to him.
A woman tries to bargain with a tofu seller or else she can’t go home. When the tofu seller refuses to negotiate, the woman devises a plan to get the tofu mischievously.
Zidan was uncomfortable with Wak Saleh's arrival because he sneezed during the pandemic. He reported to his mother and his mother taught him a spell to expel Wak Saleh.
A large family is reunited on some occasion. Everyone's happy to see each other after a long time, yet the gathering is also marked by uneasiness.

After six years of studying at a pesantren, Said returned to his village, Wonosari, only to find it drastically changed. His village was now entangled in mystical beliefs. Amid the chaos, Said reunited with Sari, his childhood sweetheart, but their relationship was hindered by Sari’s mother, Santika, who was determined to make Sari the lead dancer in the village's ritual. Unaware of the true importance of her role, Sari found herself caught in a dangerous web of intrigue involving Santika, Ningsih, and the village chief. Ningsih, who aspired to take the lead dancer's place, was willing to do anything—including using black magic—to threaten Sari. Meanwhile, Ki Dalang, the leader of the ritual, struggled to uncover who truly possessed the qualities to become the lead dancer. This search led to a confrontation with dark forces that threatened everyone involved. This tale, rich in mystery and conflict, tests the limits of love, trust, and tradition.
A seven-year-old Indonesian stand-up comedian knows precisely how to milk the parent-child relationship onstage.

Unexpectedly, a man named Bumi met a girl named Paris. Starting with a silly misunderstanding, their story evolved into love. Unfortunately, a fact emerged that Paris was still connected to a traumatic event from Bumi's past.
Martin and iBob wake up in a kitchen, tied up. They’ve been dragged into a crazy game run by two psychopathic food vloggers.
Two people are found by Dr. Tommy and Dr. Pao Pao in a remote forest, having not eaten for years. When brought to the laboratory, they turn into ZOMBIES!
Indonesia has many great heroes who fight for the independence of this republic. But legally, the number of female heroes in Indonesia is very small compared to the number of male heroes.
Sultan Usama makes a partnership agreement with Lady Sacha. But during the signing, something unexpected happens!
After a devastating tsunami, a woman realizes that what she was searching for was never truly lost.
Rules are not made to restrict, but to protect.

Setelah diputuskan oleh pacarnya, Gilang tidak bisa menerima kenyataan dan mengalami sebuah perubahan dalam dirinya. Dia mencoba untuk mengatasi rasa kehilangan dengan berdandan layaknya seorang perempuan. Gilang berpikir dengan menjadi seorang perempuan, dia dapat memiliki seorang perempuan tersebut seutuhnya.  Pencarian jati diri ini membuat Gilang terperosok ke dalam krisis identitas. Belum lagi, Gilang mulai mendapat banyak penolakan secara sosial dan diasingkan oleh sahabat-sahabatnya. Perubahan yang dia lakukan tidak berdampak baik dalam kehidupan  bermasyarakat. Merasa tertekan, Gilang akhirnya mengalami konflik batin dan memutuskan untuk menemui seseorang untuk mencari sebuah tuntunan. Pertemuan ini mempertemukan dua pandangan yang saling bertolak belakang dan dapat digunakan sebagai pelajaran kehidupan.
A short film by Satria Adiyasa
a short film by Rizqy Vajra
A short film by Arie Surastio
A girl who doesn't like eating vegetables refuses the free lunch provided by her school.
A music producer who has a perfect family. However, he has a prankster nature that causes problems in his life.

After Sita's disappearance at Mount Sarangan on Drupadi's 10th birthday, Tito's attitude became cold, leaving Drupadi sad. Her boyfriend, Raka, and her best friends, Maya, Ucok, Jamal, and Nurul, along with her parents' friends Bagus and Oji, and her uncle, Gancar, provided support for Drupadi. However, this was not enough, and on her 17th birthday, Drupadi set off for Mount Sarangan to search for her mother.

Infidelity — a word that, for some, is unforgivable. For others, it holds a certain beauty, especially when it happens within an unhappy relationship. It is both a habit and a dilemma. A psychological affliction that, for those who commit it in secrecy, can feel strangely beautiful.

Sastro Atmodjo was an Indonesian force army. He fight for Indonesian independence day. He is the only one who life after all of his friend dead. He is very disapointed with Indonesia condition now. He give up to fight the reality at the present.

Wahyudi, Ropik, Ade, and Wanto share their daily lives as anak lori (cart boys). These children try to survive by offering push cart transportation services—carts used to carry passengers and goods, often utilized by residents of Dau Atas village, Ancol-Jakarta.
A documentary to raise public awareness of mangrove forests. Mangrove forests function to filter waste from the land, and acts as a breakwater from the rising tides.
A teacher must unravel the strings of occurrences that may connect with him after a tragedy strikes at a school where he teaches.
Three snorricam perspectives on the events that led to the death of Black Tom.
Two high school students from vastly different worlds form a quiet bond that heals their hidden wounds and alters their perspectives on life, family, and hope.

This film shows the extremely brutal history the native population of West Papua have endured for many decades under the oppressive Indonesian Military.  And shows how to this day, the West Papuans continue their struggle for independence from Indonesia, including historical footage of events showing the UN "shame" vote -  Act of 'NO' Choice which lead to their colonisation and the continuing plunder, of the West Papuan's natural resources.  Filmed undercover in West Papua in 1999 - 2001 and combined with historical footage obtained from various sources.

Hardjono, a ketoprak performer whose art is a calling of the soul, is faced with an unavoidable situation. He tells his story through a letter to his beloved. Friends and neighbors come urging him to flee, as the leader of his ketoprak troupe has already been arrested. But Hardjono stands firm. Soldiers and a mob arrive to take him away, leaving a trail of blood on the floor of his home.
a short film by Ratih Prebatasari
A young man embarks on a time-travel mission to prevent the spread of the COVID-19 virus.

A female student is unable to accept the fact that she is now entering her final week in high school. She cannot accept it because, in her opinion, life after high school is a time filled with many things she has never thought about before.
A teenage girl who experiences terrible terror in her boarding house after having a nightmare, but it was all in a dream. until then she woke up and experienced the same thing as the nightmare

For Sukirno’s family and the residents of Karang Village, rain is not just a natural event, but it is a vital source of life. This film portrays how they depend on every drop to meet their daily needs and harvest rainwater in preparation for the long, dry season. A quiet portrait of human resilience, living in rhythm with nature as the seasons shift.

Salim and Rifa had a marriage full of love and happiness, until Rifa passed away. Salim refuses to fall in love again and chooses to focus on looking after his daughter, Nasya. Salim's loyalty is tested when he meets Mila.

Bonar has just fallen out of love with Cantika and is trying to rise from his downturn with the help of his two friends, Awang and Wongso. They also received offers to become rain charmers to earn money.
Fawwaz and Nanda will take you on an exciting journey to explore the best tourist spots—from cultural landmarks to seaside escapes—in North Jakarta!

Generally, we know that a kuntilanak often cries and laughs, but we never really understand why. One day, Ms. K, out of boredom, decides to try a dating app and ends up meeting Mr. P. Eventually, they go on a date.
This film tells about dreams, wishes, and what motivates people who work as extras in film and TV production in Jakarta.
A young street musician is always asked for money by a group of thugs on the stretch of road he passes every day.  Does he dare to fight back?

A scavenger boy who lives and works in Bantar Gebang, the biggest garbage dump in Indonesia, finds a lost dog which belong to a wealthy family, and bring it back to its owner. Witnessing the dog’s life, he realizes that it lives a far better life than he ever does. When he got busted stealing money from his employer, he run away from Bantar Gebang, and decided to have a better life as he knows it.
This is our home, Indonesia, with all its beauty to enjoy and its flaws to improve. Indonesia is my home.
"Indonesia is Harmony" is what Indonesia means to Ginanti Rona. According to her, this country is a harmony that arises from its many differences. However, ultimately, it can create harmony.
Honesty isn't just about actions and decisions. It's a value..
When you share a smile, that's when you share happiness.

Max Paddle Pop and Liona discovering a signal emanating from Earth, specifically the city of Orbis, indicating a dangerous situation. They find that Shadow Master is collaborating with Pixel Devil to create a game called Glitch, which has a negative impact on the minds of its players. Arka, a child from Orbis, becomes entangled in the adventure and joins Max and Liona in their quest to stop Shadow Master.
A child plays in the backyard. He is ignorant of anything going on around him...
A short film by Abdul Aziz M
When Javanese people can't read Javanese script, absurd or humorous situations unfold.
a short documentary by SKP-HAM Sulawesi Selatan

A child with a disability longs to go to school. However, in the area where he lives, there are no schools equipped to accommodate his condition. He even experienced mistreatment when he tried attending a regular public school. Eventually, he spends his days working as a palm oil laborer, using part of his wages to pay for his medical treatment.
A short film by Charles Edward

One afternoon, two strangers cross paths by chance. Genda, a young woman facing a personal struggle, slowly opens up to Handi, a stranger willing to listen. As their conversation unfolds, secrets begin to surface one by one.
Best friends, Mala and Risa spend a day at the park, but for some reason, strange things keep happening to them.
Everytime the word ‘hallo’ is heard, something happens.

Three years have passed since the “The Prince” syndicate was arrested. However, instead of being wiped out, “The Prince” and “Big Bill” continue to exist, competing for control over the drug trade. Falih is a member of the “The Prince” syndicate. His father, Mr. Iman, is deeply disappointed and intends to report his son's involvement in the drug cartel to the authorities. Unfortunately, he reports it to the wrong person—a police officer who is secretly part of “The Prince” cartel. This report puts both Falih and his younger brother, Danen, in grave danger.

Sebuah film horor komedi Indonesia yang menceritakan kisah empat mahasiswa film yang mengharuskan mereka membuat film horor sebagai proyek akhir mereka untuk menyelesaikan studi. Namun, peristiwa mistis seperti penampakan hantu dan kerasukan mulai mengganggu proses syuting mereka, mengacaukan produksi dan keselamatan tim.

This short documentary follows Eko and Abdul, who work as riders on the Tong Setan, also known as the “Wall of Death.” They’ve been doing this dangerous job for years. Their friend Jeglek now manages the night market where the ride is set up. The film is inspired by a song of the same name by the Indonesian band Bangkutaman.
The tragic side of life is portrayed by a woman forced to become a prostitute, trying to survive and feed her family.
a short film by Wicaksono Wisnu Legowo
A short documentary by Mahatma Putra and Dennis Hasangapon
A young woman investigates the complex mix of opportunities and challenges connected to her cross-cultural heritage.

An interpretation by the filmmakers of a dark chapter in Indonesia's history—the women's movement (GERWANI). Between late 1965 and mid-1966, its members were subjected to mass arrests, rape, imprisonment without trial, and even execution.

During the political coup of 1965, a man accused of being a communist decided to learn magic power in order to take revenge of the serial killer who murdered his wife. However, after the revenge is carried out, he still cannot get over the death of his beloved wife.
A story about Marceli. A Deuteranopian (Color Vision Deficiency) trying to overcome his shorctoming.

Suryati’s happiness is shattered by a letter rejecting her marriage request. Her fiancé, Suryono, a soldier, is forced to obey his superior's orders—citing her grandfather’s ID, marked “ET,” as the reason for denial.
Umar, a student, is tasked by his wise teachers to carry out community service in the aftermath of Mount Kelud’s eruption.
A story about a silent, but deep struggle. About a caregiver who loves unconditionally, with a heart that never asks for something back.

Ahok first gained wide public recognition as Jokowi’s running mate in the 2012 Jakarta gubernatorial election. But what happened when Ahok campaigned on his own, among the people of Bangka Belitung? This documentary follows his 2009 journey as he campaigned to run for a seat in the Indonesian House of Representatives representing Bangka Belitung.
This is the story behind the creation of a chicken dish on a Padang restaurant’s menu.

This country is home to educational institutions with a long and storied history. For centuries, they have weathered countless events and embraced change after change. These institutions are rooted in religious tradition, yet closely tied to local culture with its diverse customs and heritage. They have always engaged in dialogue with their surroundings and have become part of global civilization. One such institution is the *Pondok Pesantren*, the popular name for this type of school. Guided by the principle, “Preserve good traditions and adopt better innovations,” pesantrens continue to live, grow, and serve their communities. It is no surprise that along their journey, pesantrens remain strong in tradition while constantly innovating. Nor is it surprising that they have become woven into many aspects of life—spanning religion, the arts, social affairs, and even nation-building.

On February the 26th, 2010, a girl from Bajawa, Yohana Veronca Mole, ended her life by jumping into the crater of Kelimutu. This incident left deep scar in Yuliana, a middle-aged woman who is also the mother of Vera. Several years later, on 2014, Yuliana tried remembering back the bitter memory from her deceased daughter’s photographs, the recording of her funeral procession, and the footage of the ritual for the dead. Yuliana told everything she could remember on the death of her daughter.

Tommy is a designer. He has been toiling away at a website design but his colleague accuses him of plagiarism. To Tommy's dismay, even his boss is unimpressed and hits the roof, bellowing at Tommy to rework the entire design and stay up all night if he must. Without a choice, Tommy hunkers down to pull an all-nighter in the office. Late at night with no one else around, terror strikes. Is he alone in the office, or not?

Lily and Jay were flying in the Jakarta Capital sky, and decided to talk about how they would die and be remembered. But their conversation came to a halt, because Lily could never answer several of Jay’s questions.
Two people, Jameun and Jinoe, whose lives stand in stark contrast. Between modern life and village life, it unfolds like a diorama of the reality of modern Acehnese society.
Without clear reason, Corporal Jono is being held as a hostage by Jatisari Gangster. With his magic, Sergeant Rebo succeeded to free him.
A short film by Sirojuddin

A reflection on the 1965/1966 tragedy at Kreteg Bacem in Solo, where victims were killed and discarded, and their families—after decades of silence—seek remembrance through the Javanese ritual Sadranan.

Horse racing is a popular folk tradition in Sumbawa. The riders are children whose lives are far less fortunate than the horse owners. These young jockeys ride wild horses without proper safety equipment for only a small reward—a story of victory, pride, gambling, and sorrow.
When a young boy learns too much too soon and becomes afraid of making his classmate pregnant, he tries to make amends by selling bead games.
In fast-changing Papua, a mother stammers through fear and uncertainty as industry and fading traditions reshape her world.

Perkenalkan, Nama Kami JKT48 is a concert film capturing JKT48’s 2013 summer tour, the JKT48 5 Cities Concert Tour. Within six days, the idol group performed seven high-energy shows across five major Indonesian cities: Makassar, Solo, Balikpapan, Surabaya, and three shows at Tennis Indoor Senayan in Jakarta. The film features popular performances of songs such as Heavy Rotation, River, and Oogoe Diamond. This concert film was officially released on DVD under the title JKT48 in Concert – “Perkenalkan, Nama Kami JKT48” (July 4th 2013 Tennis Indoor Senayan Concert) on December 7, 2013.
A short film by Mohammad Ifdhal

A documentary film that explores the political events before and after the 1965 tragedy in Indonesia, known as Gestok (1st October Movement). The film features interviews with people who lived through and were involved in those events, offering different views from what was commonly told during the New Order era. The film aims to show the political tensions between different groups—such as the military, student activists, religious organizations, and left-wing movements—and how these tensions led to the violent events of 1965 and the change in government.
A short film by Rumekso Setyadi
a short film by Yusron Fuadi
A short film by Ilman Nafai
a short film by M. Irfan Ramli
a short film by Yuni Etifah
Tells the story of love and marriage between Fajar and Rahma, who come from Javanese and Minang cultures, as well as the conflicts that arise due to differences in family traditions on both sides.
A Father, a son, and a stranger cross path in a place where the heat of the sun can either burn or warm old wounds.

This documentary follows Tamara a 24-year-old, Waria, living in the city of Jogja in central Java, Indonesia, as she struggles to overcome poverty when a law banning her main source of income is passed.
a short film by Maria Rosiana Sedjahtera
Sandy is a beautiful transgender who works as a seamstress. She has found the love of her life and so excited to get the chance to make her own wedding gown.
A short film by Hanung Bramantyo
One night, a mother hears a mysterious knock at her door. Some time later, her husband experiences the same unsettling event.
As pupils at a school for the visually impaired, best friends Diana and Fitri are living full and complicated lives in spite of their sensory limits.
Ahmad, a porn obsessed taxi driver from Jakarta, falls for the beautiful young prostitute Kinar and struggles with sexual frustration and misguided piety.

Elang, who lived in the flat, is often haunted by images of bizarre murders involving a killer with a rabbit costume. His efforts to solve the mystery and save the lives of the people he presumed in danger, has in turn trapped him in a downward spiral and he became a suspect himself. In proving his innocence, he will be forced to unveil a horrible and long-buried secret.

Filmed by Indonesian workers during their working hours on rubber and palm oil plantations, this film exposes the devastating role of militarism and repression in building the “global economy.” Through chilling first hand accounts, hilarious improvised interventions, collective debate, and archival footage, the film explores the relationships between trade, Third World debt, and international institutions like the IMF and World Bank.
director: Joshua Oppenheimer, Christine Cynn, Anar, Basir, Erman, Hayati, Jumiati, Karman, Kirman, Mirza, Misnan, Muntoha

overview: An omnibus about fighting corruption in our daily life: in workplace, in our family, in school.
director: Sha Ine Febriyanti, Chairun Nissa, Emil Heradi, Lasja F. Susatyo

overview: A real estate entrepeneur comes to Kabayan's village in West Java making false promises, including marriage to a woman he likes, if he sells the village's land to him. Kabayan tries to save his village and also win the heart of a woman.

When Galang tries to forget her fiance, fate brings him to Laras, a sweet girl who melts his heart. Unfortunately, Galang's temperament distanced himself from Laras. Not intentionally, Galang successfully beat up Lara's father who he suspected a criminal. Lara's father also had to be hospitalized because of good intentions of Galang who spread peanut butter.  Galang and Lara's love increasingly complicated by the presence of a new boarding house residents, Donny. Youth calm but this cunning, guile have a million in his brain to get the heart Laras. Strategy struggle of "muscle" versus "brain" between Galang and Donny grab attention of Laras who was unavoidable. Discos and aided by a motivator psychiatric first-class, Galang trying to control his emotions in order to win the battle against Donny

Linda is a young woman of Chinese heritage whose mother converted to Christianity after gaining some fame as a badminton player. Her friend Cahyono is tired of anti-Chinese prejudice and now tells people he's from Japan. Together, they try to make sense of their place in the Indonesian society.
A marriage counselor reels from his own marital woes when the struggle to start a family with his eager wife puts their marriage on shaky ground.

The legend of Yamashita's Gold lures a treasure hunter and his group deep into the Indonesian jungle. Once they are trapped in an abandoned World War II Japanese bunker, they face the terrifying reality that the only way out is to go further in.

A group of film students travel to a mysterious village named the Kalimati to make a documentary. While there, one of the students leaves with a necklace, leaving the students plagued with an evil curse.
Impressed by Bagyo's fame, a political party asks him to run for election. Through the course of his campaign, he discover that there are more important things than big names and popularity.
In the aftermath of a tragic event, a teacher has to overcome his guilt when he begins working with a girl who is deaf, blind and mute.

After experiencing a tragedy that took the life of her fiancé on Pulau Pengantin, Tiara decided to calm herself at a beach in Phuket, Thailand. She opened a small bar with her friend Lea and took the opportunity to study Thai Boxing as a way to channel her anger and trauma from the past. One day, her college friend Alan, who still had feelings for Tiara, came to visit and intended to persuade Tiara to return to Indonesia. Alan came with his niece Maureen, and nephews Kenny and Aida. As a good host, Lea quickly arranged their vacation, visiting the islands around Phuket. But when their boat broke down, they had to stop at a strange island. Tiara realized that something was odd on the island. She felt that her past would always chase her, wherever she went. This time, Tiara decided she would not run away. She would face it.

Returning from Mecca, Darwis changes his name to Ahmad Dahlan as he is disturbed by the trend of Islamic laws in his society; that borders on heresy, Syrik (polytheism), and Bid’ah (wrong innovation). Using a compass, he proves that the direction of Qibla (that points to Mecca), in the Great Mosque of Kauman is wrong. The discovery angers every Kyai (Islamic experts), especially the head of the Great Mosque of Kauman, Kyai Penghulu Cholil Kamaludiningrat. Dahlan, who studied in Mecca for five years, is seen as a rebel upstart. Since the proposal of changing the direction of Qibla is rejected, Dahlan starts a movement calling for the change. On his first sermon as a preacher, Dahlan criticizes the habits of residents in his village in Yogyakarta: "In a prayer, only a sincere and patient heart is needed, it requires no Kyais, money, let alone offerings". As a result, Dahlan gets a hostile reception.
A love story of a Moslem freelance journalist and a Catholic college girl, in resistance by their different cultures and religion.
It follows the struggle of clerics to keep Islam alive during the Japanese invasion of Indonesia in 1942.
A man who is in charge of seeding clouds to bring rain to a parched district becomes obsessed with a traditional singer.

Reta and Santi are childhood friends. Reta falls in love with David, who Santi has had an affair with. Since Reta has a serious illness, Santi decides to keep her love affair a secret. A love triangle turns into a nightmare between three friends.

VILLAGE DOES NOT MEAN THAT EMPTY uninhabited  One day after Andien, Didi, Vanilla and sparkle celebrate their birthday, apparently Didi diputusin her boyfriend, Calvin suddenly. To entertain Didi, then Andien, Vanilla, and invite sparkle for the holidays to Pangandaran Didi Didi so get over Calvin.

The story begins with the desire Yulia Sumbukurung, son of Beetle Pangkalima chairman Jaya one very well-known Dayak tribe in Kalimantan to Jakarta to continue studying. Desire is welcomed by his family. With the departure of ritual to release Yulia, Pangkalima Beetle Penyang Jaya gives a necklace, a necklace to protect Yulia from all evil.

A re-edit of the film "Rumah dan Musim Hujan" (2012) by its producers. A provocative demolition of traditional family values, the film tackles a wide range of issues, from gay secrets to marital infidelity. After a dinner to mark the end of Ramadan, we follow three siblings through the rest of the night. Ragil looks after his dad, a doddery patriarch, but has a secret lover who visits when dad's asleep. His sister Ade has a terrible experience on the way home (she's lived with mum since the divorce), but the night has greater shocks in store for her. And the randy elder brother Raga is helping his current girlfriend through a pregnancy scare when his former girlfriend shows up at the door in distress.

Ning, a young Catholic woman, takes up a better job with a furniture company, while her hapless husband—occasionally hawking gasoline—spends most of his time doing pretty much nothing. It is when Ning is required by her new job to go on a road trip with Mur, a male Muslim colleague, that the suffocation of her marriage gives way to an awakening of repressed desires. Set in Yogyakarta, this delicately observed mood piece and debut feature touches on unspoken issues of sexual repression and adultery in contemporary Indonesia.
A love-themed anthology adapted from the music album of the same title by Dewi "Dee" Lestari.
Between divorce, bad relationships and coming out as gay, a group of affluent friends realize that none of their lives are as easy as they seem.

Bayu, who is a member of elite national soccer team U-15, wants to prove that he can bring his team to win ASEAN junior competition in Jakarta. With support from his best friend, Heri, the new girl in school he is attracted to, Anya, and the new coach Mr. Wisnu, Bayu leads his friends working hard to reach the final. However, a new guy on the team, Yusuf, steals Bayu's spotlight as the rising star. Now the team is in a great mess, and Bayu runs away from the training. As the big match is approaching, can Bayu and his team bring Indonesia to victory?
A rich teen who yearns to study abroad meets an intriguing college student who could offer her some valuable insight — and potentially more.

Mar believes in the mysterious legend of the lovers Halimah and Sukab on the island of Sawai from a hundred years ago. She travels to Sawai to experience what Halimah once felt, hoping to find Sukab there.
In a story of interconnected lives, three families of different religious faiths navigate conflicting beliefs, hardships, and other struggles.

Yusuf and his cousin Ambar spend a wild night out just before heading out of town for a relative’s wedding. When the pair passes out overnight and Ambar misses her flight, the two head off on a three-day road trip. Little do they realize those three days will have a lasting impact on their lives.

Set in and around a mosque in sprawling Jakarta, Indonesia, during the Muslim holiday of Lebaran, the interwoven stories of family, faith and romantic love in this humorous yet poignant film are revealed through the eyes of kids.
Determined to discover her roots, a young woman travels to Indonesia and pieces together her parents' unconventional love story.
A group of young filmmakers from Jakarta arrived in Bantul, Yogyakarta to prepare for a shoot. Things are normal until the second day when they start to experience unexplained phenomenon.

A man was heartbroken by his beloved girlfriend. They could relate distance because she had disappeared for her studies to Australia for 1 year. Suddenly they relationship end because it turns out his girlfriend dating another man. The man best friend trying to turn him back the loss of life due to a broken heart by hiring an intelligence agency that specializes in dealing with heartbreak cases, called Heart-Break.com. After committing to a long-distance relationship when Nayla overseas to study, she suddenly breaks up with Agus. Agus’s best friend, Wawan and his girlfriend, Raya, try to rescue Agus through Heart-Break.com. This romantic comedy tells of Agus’s struggle to get Nayla back using various tactics provided by Heart-Break.com.
When a sheltered young woman becomes enamored with a struggling writer, she goes to great lengths to become involved in his creative process.
With just 10 days until her wedding, Amanda's world is turned upside down when her ex suddenly reappears, forcing her to question everything she thought she wanted.

Jamila is a prostitute serving a life sentence behind bars. She surrenders herself to the authorities after admitting she killed a high-ranking minister, and refuses to be represented by any lawyer or request a plea to ease her sentence.
Two friends who are bored with their respective partners decide to do a crazy idea that challenges their love story.

A compilation of nine short films and collected scenes created by young, up-and-coming Indonesian directors. Set during a single hot Jakarta night. Each short features an interaction between two characters and focuses on the strange situations one might get into while prowling the city after dark.
director: Ifa Isfansyah, Tumpal Tampubolon, Agung Sentausa, Rico Marpaung, Anggun Priambodo, Wisnu Surya Pratama, Sidi Saleh, Edwin, Azhar Kinoi Lubis

overview: The filmmaker Ascan Breuer searches for the spirit of a tiger said to have haunted the house of his ancestors on Java. This search combines an autobiographical narrative thread involving the history of the filmmaker's family and a historical narrative about migration that spans the globe.

When a boy is too confused to speak with his non-communicative family, words eventually lose their meaning. He decides to communicate with his dandruff and a cup of cold coffee instead. His father ignores these eccentricities, assuming it is just a ploy to get attention. Meanwhile, the boy's sister likes exercising seductively in front of men and is better able to capture her father's attention than her brother. Their mother is oblivious, perpetually talking to people on her mobile phone and the space the family occupies grows narrower and narrower.

Kara is a little girl living in an isolated place. Her father disappeared after Ronald killed her mother. A journalist's invasion of her life makes her decide to seek out Ronald and ask him the ultimate question.

In the rhythm of a slow visual journey, "The Land Beneath the Fog" takes an intimate look on family relations in Genikan, a village on the slope of Merbabu Mountain. A quiet community faces change without understanding why it happens. As a community of farmers who rely on traditional Javanese calendar system to read the seasons, they become puzzled by the dramatic change of seasons. Describing a life on the brink of vanishing, this documentary offers deep insights into an invisible and disenfranchised society which is struggling hard underneath its veiled existence.
When a journalist researches a story on corruption in a football league, her investigation leads to the potential involvement of a star player.

A video artist working on his latest project, is unexpectedly visited by his long lost friend, Jansen. Jansen is having a troubled relationship with his wife. He escapes the city and meet him who has gone through a similar problem. During their awkward reunion, they became aware of how far apart they have grown, and at the same time unfolding each others breakdowns. Rocket Rain touches on the human longing for inner peace within the shifting values of contemporary Indonesian family. In a country where traditions are considered sacred, the concept of nature and social values are being mediated by the demands of modernity. Rocket Rain is a story of people who are trying to cope with this complexity of endless contradictions.
Satrio and Natasha met in an incident. Satrio who is interested in Natasha decides to help her find the owner of a diary of a man named "Boy".
Three women from three different social, economic, and ethnic groups discuss their lives in polygamous household.
Cina and Annisa love God and God loves them both. But Cina and Annisa cannot love each other because they call God by different names.

Anissa struggles as a child, a mother and a wife in the environment of a conservative Islamic tradition. The hope of becoming an independent Muslim woman for Anissa collapsed amidst the obstacles of her conservative family.

Four women, four cities, four unflinching stories—this powerful omnibus film weaves together the struggles of women across Indonesia, from a midwife battling corruption to a teenager caught in betrayal, a mother fighting for her child, and a widow facing the harsh truth of survival.
director: Nia Dinata, Upi Avianto, Lasja F. Susatyo, Fatimah Rony

overview: Silent short (with music and inter-titles) telling an old Indonesian folk tale of a princess who ends up married to a dog.

Amelia was a lonely 10-year-old girl. Ratna, her mother, was too busy working. Amelia, who feels neglected, befriended her cousin, Ambar. When the holidays arrived, Amelia decided to visit Ambar in her village.
A deeply religious young woman spends one powerful evening reconnecting with a long-lost parent, who now makes a living as a sex worker in Jakarta.
The story of three young men, Doni, Juan and Alex, who is married but can not eliminate their playboy nature. They have always plays with the Sexy girls.

The day Kara turned 18, he had to lose everything, a gift from his grandfather that he would never forget in his lifetime. Taken in by a family who believes he is poor, he works towards supporting himself and new relationships.

Kumbang (Adipati Dolken) and his three friends, Abdu (Kemal Palevi), Daniel (Herichan), and Basuki (Zidni Adam), are always causing havoc at school. All of them are crazy about and always tease Olive (Tatjana Saphira), a smart & clever girl in their class. Eventually, his antics and academic failures forces the principal (Ray Sahetapy) to assign Olive to be Kumbang's mentor. Olive hesitates, though Kumbang sees this as an opportunity to get close to her.

Conscience begins with the story of heartbreak experienced by the two main characters: Randi (Boy Hamza) who has just left his girlfriend, Dera (Kimberly Ryder), because it chose to pursue her career as a model and Fila (Joanna Alexandra) who realized that the friend he had admired for 10 years, Adrian (Arnhezy Arczhanka), it was established in love with someone else. One unintended meeting in a cafe finally introduce two people who were hit by the turmoil of the heart with each other. And as can be expected ... tersebutlah introductions and then slowly begin to heal the wounds of love in the hearts of each one.

Four friends who live in a rented namely Momon, Farhan, Alfin and Juned also lectures on the same campus. Mobs are insufficient pursue her love of materialistic model, Sasha. While Farhan chose pious veiled girl who was short of money, Aisha. The problem is further complicated when they rescue Sheila from men who cheat their money and needed a place to stay temporarily. Money and love seems to continue to be a difficult problem solved.

Two debt collectors crazy, Dom and Mino, accidentally met a mad woman, and Cindy Mey. Dom and Mino trapped and Cindy Mey crazy game. They made ​​off with Mey of marriage. The tragedy is blurred bridal make Mey and Cindy's father's wrath. Mey and Cindy, are the spoiled children of Jakarta conglomerate, fond of debauchery, and crazy spending money. Their father eventually block the credit card as well as all the facilities. Cindy and Mey's father mustered all his men, including Gary, prospective fiancée Mey, to hunt down Dom and Mino.
A football team who has differences and ego problems must win an International underground football tournament in order to save their own lives.
Dara, an enigmatic and beautiful woman with macabre secrets, invites an unwitting bachelor into her home. But when two unexpected suitors arrive, all hell breaks loose.
Fueled by love, rebellion, and rock 'n' roll, Radit and Jani live fast and free—until reality hits, and they’re forced to trade chaos for survival.

This fusion of documentary and fiction narrative depicts the lives of foreign migrants as an impending water crisis begins to seep into their lives. With water, or the lack of it, becoming the central motif, this two-part feature length film takes us on a journey across 8 interweaved stories and 10 languages, as the protagonists, consisting of non-professional actors, grapple with this hopefully temporary discomfort, amidst their dalliance with human foibles, and their fantasies of everlasting loves and broken romances.

After the mysterious death of her undercover cop husband, a female martial artist must protect her daughter from corrupt police, politicians and hired assassins who will do anything to conceal the truth.
Dilemma is an omnibus film, five stories that depict dark side of Jakarta's underbelly. Jakarta's underground world that seldom to talk about, and forgotten by most of the people.
director: Adilla Dimitri, Razka Robby Ertanto, Robert Ronny, Rinaldy Puspoyo

overview: Two people meet by chance in Busan, South Korea. Indah works at the Indonesian Embassy in Busan. Abi, a sailor who suffers heart attack and Indah was assigned as his guardian. Although their backgrounds are different, they learn from each other.
A tender, melancholic night is experienced through the eyes of three women as they struggle to find themselves in this ever-changing jungle of Jakarta.
After witnessing a child's death during a violent clash, a former soccer player launches a youth team to help local kids avoid further bloodshed.
A group of friends reunites for a vacation amid nature, where they laugh about their shared history and bond over difficult truths.

Geng socialite mother; Lolita was a widow who became entrepreneurs due to expensive boutiques treasure Gono-gini ex-ex-husband, Anis rather an idiot, and Uut fat, often hold joint gathering costly. By the time the three get together, the mortal enemy of Lolita, Misye, while gathering brought a popcorn (the term to refer to youth aged bear) named Erik. Misye gaze is believed to be a challenge for Lolita, which eventually terkompori and with Anis and Uut, holding auditions looking for popcorn at the shop.

It all starts when Rea invites her boyfriend Zacky to play jelangkung. Her friend scold at her for doing this but it is too late, calamity already begins. A spirit is haunting them and Rea tries to find a way to get rid of it. They go to see a paranormal, and they are told that the only way to get rid of the spirit is by pulling up a jelangkung doll that is planted one year ago in Angker Batu.

Guntur (Rangga Raditya) is an ordinary kid from a village in Banyuwangi. His father (Mamiek Prakoso) is tough on him because he wants Guntur to be a badminton champion like Liem Swie King, while his friend Raden (Lucky Martin) pushes him to take part in local match by suggesting that he might win a lot of money.  After learning that his competitive efforts only brings him trouble, he becomes mad to both his father and friend, and vow to not ever touch badminton anymore. However, his father and Raden may have secrets that Guntur doesn’t know.
An old man lures 10 women to become his wives to lift an ancient curse.

In the constant stream of hoping, failing and making new plans, Denok and Gareng stay united in their passionate struggle to make it up the hill one day. In the modest house of Gareng’s mum, these young, ex-street urchins Muslim couple starts a small pig business, looking for the lucky streak to come over the family. But new challenges constantly arise, putting their cheerfulness and patience on trial. In an entirely observational approach, ‘Denok & Gareng’ explores a strong loving relationship inside a strikingly vivid family that sticks together, fights back and laughs, about what others would call a Sisyphus fate.
A privileged teen meets her match when a blunt, outspoken young man visits from France and stays with her family.
After a temperamental pop singer is caught in possession of drugs, she evades arrest by becoming a fledgling dangdut performer in a rural neighborhood.
The relationship between four best friend turns complicated when a woman enters their lives, and once their past returns to torment them.
When a military dad rules that his oldest daughters must marry first, the youngest sibling leads a mission to get all of her sisters engaged.

8 members of JKT48 got lost in the zoo, and when they return to theatre, they find out that their theatre has been taken by Miss Kejora, who create a rival group. They must find a way to get the theatre back,

Miko is still seeking true love, along with Dovi, the most confident person who lives with him, and Anca their faithful housekeeper.  Miko always fails every time he is close to a girl. Rian, who has been a stand-up comedian in the boats, believes that it is caused by the curse of the Miko’s past, because Rian always dream to see something related to an item kept by Miko since secondary school. They are trying to trace friends from their secondary school who are likely the cause of the curse.  Dovi continues to struggle with problems of his study in law school that makes ​​him stress. He gets assignment from his lecturer to accompany a group of foreign students, Alexandra, Suzuki, and Mamadi around Jakarta and must meet specified targets. Dovi had to prove his worth for the sake of his studies.
Five years after running away from an arranged marriage, Eliana is unexpectedly visited by her mother.

The mythical figure of Srikandi, a female figure from the Indian Mahabharata epic that changes gender to live and fight as an equal among men, is the inspiration and role model for this anthology of stories on the state of alternate sexualities in Indonesia, the country with the largest Muslim population in the world. The result is eight highly personal and profound perspectives on lesbian, bisexual and trans-identity life in Islamic Indonesia.
director: Afank Mariani, Yulia Dwi Andriyanti, Angelika Levi, Stea Lim, Imelda Taurinamandala, Dian Eggie, Laura Coppens, Winnie Wibowo, Hera Danish, Oji Ijo

overview: The Bratz are as close as ever in these episodes which find the gals helping one pal build confidence while urging another to be true to herself. They've got tales to tell and lessons to learn. Stories from four fashionable pals who put friendship first.

Slank is a legendary rock band on the Indonesian scene, known for their politicized lyrics and activism, and for its fanatical fan base - known as "Slankers" - who see the band as something to coalesce around to promote peace and unity in their country. 'The Blue Generation' uniquely combines dance sequences, footage of live performances, interviews, and animations about Indonesia's political history in a gloriously energetic and inspiring manner.
director: Dosy Omar, Garin Nugroho, John De Rantau

overview: After meeting at a party, two Indonesian students studying in the US embark on a project to create a science fiction epic that will captivate the masses.

Masked Monkey opens as a classic, romantic nature film - but this quickly changes when a monkey playing in the wild is captured and the scene shifts to hectic Jakarta. Street artists use monkeys in the most incredible shows.

The docu-fiction GARUDA POWER is the final result of many years of research about Indonesian Action Movies - or what's still left of it. It focuses on Action Movies from the first Chinese-influenced martial arts movies of the 1930s, the James Bond copies of the swinging 1960s, the Bruce Lee-alikes and super hero comic book adaptations of the 1970s, the golden age of the 1980s up to recent worldwide success of the two RAID movies.
An observational documentary about the end of childhood, describing how young Muslim girls grow up in Indonesia 's middle class of today.

The world of science is shocked with the creation of sophisticated weapons as the savior of the world from giant asteroids that can hit the earth in the future. But, these weapons are successfully hijacked by a group of villain led by Durja King and transformed into a threat of destruction. But in times of crisis, GARUDA appears as a figure who has super power that can save the world.
The magical surrealist journey of Asa, daughter of a shaman, who confronts her own mother, fighting for her own life and freedom.

A young mother to her son, Siti has to find ways and means to care for the boy, her husband and her mother-in-law. By day, she sells snacks; by night, she works as a karaoke guide. Tainted by her nighttime employment, Siti finds her husband no longer wishes to speak to her.
A photoshoot in the jungle goes haywire when the models are attacked by mysterious creatures

Everything seems perfect in life Nada. He has a dream of domestic life, cute kids, and families who have always supported it. Until one day, a tragedy happened to him. The tragedy that not only claimed her soul mate, but also his family and his future. However, the tragedy and then make notes to dare to live and fight for life. This is the story of the struggle for the sake of continuity tone up and future.

Arumi is a beautiful girl, simple and gentle. But the ambition to reach his love, make softness bias into her stubborn character. Lukman is highly admired man since the hazing took place, but when love Arumi budding, Lukman married to Jean, who had long dipacarinya lover.  3 Years ago, Arumi reunited with Lukman on campus where they had both assumed knowledge. Lukman became a lecturer, and Arumi actively assist all campus activities. Lukman presence makes Arumi increasingly confident that he will get Lukman, although it must break through destiny.
Muak dengan desakan untuk menikah dari orang tuanya, seorang manajer hotel menyewa seorang aktor untuk menjadi pacarnya, tetapi aktor itu tak mau mematuhi naskah.

This film is an adaptation of the novel written by Indi. The story begin when Indi (Velove Vexia), who suffered from scoliosis, her activities became increasingly limited.
