In this research, Bima asks Via, the children of the Ikatan Cinta Orphanage and Ana et al for help. While searching for medicinal plants, Fika gets lost and is bullied by Ana et al. Bima stops the process of searching for medicinal plants and looks for Fika. In addition, the orphanage will be confiscated because it is in debt.

An ambitious career woman is taking an elevator to her office in a hurry and in the elevator there is one of her coworkers and they are both trapped in the elevator and have to wait until the elevator technician comes.

An alley in a small village is kept under tyrannical rule by a group of small children, led by a boy nicknamed El Meler. The group bullies the other children living in the alley, until a newcomer appears, who dares to oppose them.

Alea is a 16-year-old teenager who recently moved from Jakarta to Bandung. This move is also used by Alea to erase the memory of her ex-boyfriend, Reynand, who turns out to be having an affair with her best friend.

When Siti loses the attention of her biological children, who are established and busy with their respective jobs, she takes care of Murni, a psychoneurotic pregnant girl. What Siti did made her children worry and forbade her. Accompanied by her adopted son Jalu, Siti is determined to take care of Murni when her physical condition is getting weaker due to cancer.

Marapu, Fire & Ritual is a story that follows Pak Ledi, Poho Maga’s uncle, as he overcomes his family’s tarnished reputation by taking responsibility to fix the past. He believes it is the right timing to conduct a sacred four day ritual to invite the Marapu spirits back into the village. But not everyone agrees to this. Pak Ledi must first unite the village leaders.
Aileen is coming to her grandfather. She is obliged to follow rituals as a Cai Lan Gong (Vegetable Basket Deity) keeper. Something evi happens that make the ritual go wrong.
Towards Eid al-Fitr, a refugee child wants to fix his sister's clothes. However, running out of thread and having no money, he stole from a traveling tailor who was busy finishing his pile of orders.

Mrs. Yenny suddenly fainted and was unconscious. Lying in bed accompanied by her three children, Alya, Alma, Andra, and her slowly declining Alzheimer's husband, Marsio. In one tiring night of survival, a family secret is revealed. Alya will break the promise she swore to her mother she will keep. The other two children, Alma and Andra, fight for their individuality feud. In the midst of a family crisis, the children, Alya, Alma, and Andra soon realize that they don't really know anything about their own mother. Who he really is? And who is their father? Meanwhile, two doctors, Dr. Myra and Dr. Miyagi struggles with the reality of the inability of medical care in the face of imminent death.
A girl is trying to escape her “home”. In her case, it’s tranquility.

Fajar Suharno was a theater maestro from the 80's to the 90's. He was imprisoned because his theater activities were considered against the New Order government. At its peak, he made a show entitled "Geger Uwong Ngoyak Macan" about the events of crushing people who were considered thugs/criminals (Petrus). The show was held exactly the day before the massacre took place
A lesbian couple at the end of their long term relationship begin to question whether or not they completely knew each other.

This documentary tells/explains the pelebon of a pair of sulinggih in this Corona pandemic situation, the difference between pelebon/cremation as usual in Bali, with pelebon/cremation during the pandemic, especially corpses that have been exposed to covid. Then they found and used a very unique, simple method, a method very rarely used by Balinese people to carry out pelebon, namely using Tirta Prenawa Pengawak Solas. This film also inserts a "little" love story of a husband and wife until death picks them up. The couple had made a promise that the husband would die first. However, the wife did not keep her promise and died first. The husband felt disappointed, devastated, and sad because the wife did not keep her promise. Because their love is so strong that they are not separated from each other, the husband is "trusted" to "let go" of himself and then follow his wife.
My grandfather's historical narrative of the Indonesian people's movement in Malaysia which is not mentioned in official history.

Untung and Nesti really love their 6 year old son who has autism. Their daily life becomes more challenging because both of their parents are disabled, but their love and passion is truly heartwarming.

The Enigma of Hedonism are profile documentaries that tell the life of Heri Dono. His attitude and view as an artist that transcends canvas and time has had an important impact on artists and artists in other fields in their work. Not only that, his exploration of the various and types of working mediums and the experience of participating in various prestigious exhibitions in the world has made him dubbed as the greatest artist of Indonesia today.

The film tells about the various activities of citizens in 9 regions of Indonesia during the pandemic. Starting with morning activities until the evening, where the situation in each location is very different. The issue of pandemics and the application of health protocols is the most common problem in each location, as well as in other parts of the world. The existence of the Corona virus that is not visible in front of the eyes makes some residents see it as not a dangerous threat. This film records fragments of events from various perspectives of residents with their respective activities. The story of each location is combined into visual poems, which can be related or unrelated. The most important thing about this film's story is how culturally people face a pandemic which is recorded with the simplest cameras.

The efforts of Silvester, an artist who is also a civil servant at the East Flores Regency Tourism Office, in taking part in a cultural festival in his area, Lewolema, Indonesia. The Lewolema indigenous people for almost half a century have not recognized their space for cultural expression. Festivals, he believes, are celebrations where cultural egalitarian spaces are recreated. This film also portrays how to place artistic work in an effort to maintain heritage and traditions with tourism which has a different way.
The story and spirit behind the construction of the Welcome Statue (HI Roundabout), the West Irian Liberation Monument (Banteng Field), and the Dirgantara Statue (Pancoran).

When I was little, I had a dream that scared me very much. I went home, but no one recognized me. When I grew up, my dream changed. I chase my dreams, sometimes without knowing where they are taking me. This is a film about where I came from, where dreams are forgotten and love is never spoken.

Someone tells of a dream he had, which was to go fishing and get lots of fish, this kind of dream is often associated with a symbol of good luck. But he was afraid that the dream would happen again and again, from generation to generation.

Salmiyah explores fragments of memory, perceptions of historical actors, history buffs, and audiences. The past, always leaves questions, it can never come back in its full form. People are competing with each other to create their own history. Salmiyah is an attempt to describe the complexity of history which is always full of bias and distance.

One day, my mother asked me to come home. When he got home, he asked everyone, including me, to vote for a Muslim mayoral candidate. I turned it down because I didn't agree. Therefore, the mother forced to choose based on religious arguments. Until finally the regional head election was over, I didn't vote for anyone.

Set in an Indonesian suburban Middle-Class neighborhood, Udin’s Inferno, tells a story about 12 years old kid named Udin, who got traumatized after reading a comic book about a depiction of hell torture. In the book, Udin sees a very graphic and disturbing violent depiction of tormented sinners that haunts him throughout the day. One of the sinners in the book is a person who got a tattoo in his life. One of his friends mocks Udin, a tattooed person in the book is Udin’s father, a guy who got tattoos all over his body. Udin thinks if he can manage to erase his father’s tattoo, he can save him and his father from getting to hell in the afterlife. Udin tries all efforts to erase his father’s tattoo which he obviously fails. Udin cannot deal with his obvious failure. He got even more haunted by his own depiction of hell not only when he was awake, but also in his sleep. In the end, his fears and trauma turn into a nightmare.
Study together during the day
When his birthday dawns, Adam struggles to soothe his own thoughts that prevent him from sleeping.

Murni wants to be ronggeng but she doesn't want tradition  to serve men keep going. With the help of Pandu, her  educated little friend, they try  lying to the public that Murni has opened  "kelambu" with him. But the lie doesn't work  smooth when she rejects other men who want to sleep  with her and made all the citizens turn around  insulted her. This made Pandu expelled, they thought  educated people are against the culture and both of them  finally separated.

Nadia (15) spends her last day riding a motorbike with her boyfriend with among feelings of loss before leaving Palu and being sent to Islamic Border School by her Dad (50) who always forbids her from dating.
Naura,19, ended her long-distance relationship after her boyfriend revealed a different side of him.
Cunenk grew up as a girl trapped in a boy’s body. She could not wait to leave her village and become a performer.
When the past and secret secrets, the thin line is capable of engendering hatred. Nares is caught between her family's past and a secret about her.

Faced with her adult children’s impending departures, an aging widow’s sudden fall triggers deep-seated family conflicts and an unexpected attempt at matchmaking, leaving the family’s future harmony in her hands.
One night Monalisa is getting asked by mysterious voice from her body.

On the early pandemic of Covid-19, Adel's family struggles to maintain livelihood as her mother had her work terminated by the office. The family consist of 5 kids to protect. So by then, they decided to open a family business, lead by her mom as she knows the best about food. With everyone helping around and discussing the future of the business, it led to many adventure for them as family.
The struggles between Rara, Zayn, Eliza, Abdul, and Yasmin who chase each other for love and their dream to build a shop.

Kemed who was hurt by Eros three years earlier. A few days before the wedding between Eros and Joseph. Kemed who saw the invitation still think of Eros who will marry Joseph his friend, while in cibarengkong the youth bet who the future husband of Eros. With various efforts finally kemed managed to meet Eros. Finally because of his great love for Eros he decided to kidnap Eros.

Nirmala, a young woman full of dreams with a fear of darkness, involves in an intimate relationship with the Sun. Living with her protective Aunt, Nirmala begins to find comfort in Bayu, her close friend. As they get closer, Nirmala strays away from the Sun, unknowingly bringing darkness into her life.
Withstanding misery, a young man who seemed to live like an ordinary person suffers and tries to seek help from the closest person named friend.
In the aftermath of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, a young girl in Aceh who survived serves as an inspiration to others while coping with her own grief.

The story of Bara (Arbani Yasiz) and Melati (Maizura) continues in Ada Dewa di Sisiku the Movie. Bara and Melati have now been in a relationship for three years, but Melati feels that their relationship is not progressing. Melati wants to take their relationship to a more serious level.
When a filmmaker is having his drought because of a tragic love story. He realized that his friends are the ones he need.
Two market thugs with all their troubles.
The woman would be happy if the man sit to her right. But the man always prefers to be on the left.

Lost told about Intan who was sitting on the swing alone and suddenly Deffa came and sat next to her to accompany her. They became friends from childhood to adulthood and they gave each other surprises on birthdays until finally Deffa, who was diagnosed with brain cancer, gave Intan a birthday surprise for the last time.

Bagas's struggle to make Nadhira a better woman. When Nadhira had become an almost perfect woman, Nadhira actually married another man. On their way, Bagas and Nadhira tried to let go. Can the two of them forgive each other? Or are they getting back together?
After dedicating years of service at a matchmaking company, Arini tries to piece together her mysterious past — and memories of a former client.

In 1965, Indonesian artist Amrus Natalsya was one of the many artists arrested during the violent purge of communists and their sympathisers, after the failed coup by the September 30th Movement. Natalsya was released in 1973.
Astrid, a super famous artist who has many fans. Although successful in a career, Astrid's relationship with her boyfriend, Permana, is problematic.
An upper-class family deals with the mother's sudden Alzheimer's.
This is a story about Bimo and Arimbi. They share their future, about uncertainty, and how their life after swearing to each other forever.
Ayu (35), a woman who works in Jakarta decided to kidnap Clara (9), her employer's daughter to her hometown.

Ambo Nai was fired as an interregional passenger driver when his wife was heavily pregnant. However, his hopes were dashed when he received information from his friend that the fishmonger in Bajoe, Bone Regency, South Sulawesi was in need of a driver to take his fish to the city. Ambo Nai is sure that he can be accepted for work. He does not know the competition with fellow drivers in places where the fishmongers are very tough. The innocent Ambo Nai only has passion and honesty. He got the opportunity to work with the fishmonger. However, Ambo Nai has to deal with Blonde Boss and his minions, who have been controlling fish delivery at the skipper's place. When there was a special delivery to Makassar, the jury gave their trust to Ambo Nai, not to Bos Pirang who tried to thwart Ambo Nai's mission.

Riau Province has been a habitat for Sumatran elephants since ancient times. Massive forest clearing occurred and resulted in almost the entire forest as elephant habitat being lost to oil mining factories, infrastructure buildings, community gardens and settlements. Loss of habitat causes elephants to enter populated areas and destroy plantations, even people's homes. Until finally a conflict arose between the residents of Karya Indah and wild elephants. This living space conflict occurs almost every day and causes losses and even casualties between the two parties.
Trapped in her own marriage as housemaid, Tiara would do anything to escape her banal days.

Dody Iskandar, Abdul Karim, and Taufik Zulfikri are three blind individuals with different levels of visual impairment. All three have a passion for watching and producing films, and express this passion by watching films, producing films independently, and playing an active role as participants in Inklusi Film Indonesia (INFI), a community for individuals with disabilities to produce and enjoy films.
An older sister searches for her missing sister in a remote village with a mysterious man she just met.

Radit wants to take part in the Campground Week which will be held by his elementary school. But he turned into sadness and disappointment because the overprotective attitude of Radit's mother always didn't approve of his favorite child to take part in activities outside the home that were too dangerous. But Radit did not give up and found a way to still the feeling of camp.
This is an analogy to the story about the presidential election. glasses are a tool for walking, you should choose glasses that can't be wrong because it will interfere with the way forward.

A photographer named Danny has numerous problems continuously in his life, and thus can't make him believe with a saying "The Earth Rotates". He feels like he's always been in the same position until had a journey that changes his mind.

A photographer named Danny doesn't like his education and likes photography instead, while his father doesn't support him because he sees photography as an unpromising field of work. Secretly, Danny's father also has other reasons that Dany never knew.
Though the drug does not belong to him, importing heroin gets Acai Nakrim locked up in jail which then leads to his death penalty. Before the execution day, he flees with the help of an old man.

After 15 years of marriage and adopting two brothers Alani and Vito, Amelia became pregnant. In order to take care of his wife, who also suffers from high blood pressure, Verdi the husband, moved from Jakarta to a plantation company at the foot of Mount Salak.  Problems arise when the house they live in appears by the spirit of a woman who in the past lost a baby in her womb due to a mystical event. Now the spirit has come, trying to penetrate into Amelia's body to judge the baby in her womb. Vito and Alani, who realize the danger, try to protect their mother even though they have to face a life-threatening threat.  But as it turned out, the woman's spirit was the only danger he faced. There are other, more sinister forces that have never been thought of before.

Because of his political activities, Sukarno was exiled to Ende in 1934. He went with his wife Inggit Garnasih, daughter Ratna Djuami alias Omi, and mother-in-law Amsi. The initial period in exile was difficult. The most painful thing is that no local people dare to speak to him and everywhere he is always followed by the police.
A group of criminals stole the Atlantis Crown at the Jakarta museum, Lapor Pak! team must quickly rediscover the crown to be returned to the museum before their careers are in danger of ending.

Distance and time apart inspired the song " Walau Ku Jauh " by David Noah, beautifully performed by Christie. The single's powerful message also inspired the creation of a short film titled "Happy Anniversary."

Maryana, a batik designer, conducted research in Singkawang to find original batik motifs from her homeland. He met Wina's friends, who met Hasan, a teacher who eventually became her husband. Their marriage was shaken because of Sarah's phone call asking Hasan for help. Hasan feels bad for Sarah's family who once helped him. This made Maryana misunderstand, especially when there was a call from the hospital saying that Hasan's wife was going to give birth

Agave Amica transports us to Indonesia in the midst of the pandemic. With an excellent eye and a unique form of narration, Gembong Nusantara follows the daily lives of workers and their toil both in graveyards and in flower fields, inviting us to a larger reflection on the contrast between day and night, life and death, flowers and graves.

Hakim really wants to go on a trip to the zoo, but his parents don't have enough money for three vacations. The father also did a way to be able to fulfill his son's desire to go on vacation to the Zoo

A story about the family of victims of the Lapindo mudflow, Sidoarjo. Delta Santoso's entire life was immortalized to see his mother, Sriyani, whatever the situations and conflicts in life she faced. The disaster that hit Sriyani was not only the Lapindo mudflow, but also the husband who took himself to another woman without giving status. As a result, Sriyani has to fulfill her daily needs and pay for the schooling of her two children, Delta and Iqbal. He works as a washing iron worker while selling lontong kupang, which he sells himself on his parents' bicycle.

A Sumatran elephant calf is being hunted for smuggling. This incident caught the attention of five children who were camping nearby. Tensions rise when elephant hunters target the five children. In the dense forest, they have to self-report by car. When they arrived in the city, they secretly took the Sumatran elephant calf into the freight train. The five children had the courage to save the Sumatran elephant calf from the elephant hunters.

All Pandji's worries during 2021 are summarized in this Special Show. It didn't stop there, Pandji also did a lot of research about the problems in the world of government which was currently hot at the time. Various deep messages about life are very thick delivered in this Stand-Up Comedy Show.
A young islander man who travels all the way from the Kepulauan Seribu to the big city, Jakarta, to pursue his dream. Faced with one obstacle after another, will he succeed and achieve his dream?
After an accident that killed both of Tara's parents, Tara now only has a younger brother named Gian as a member of her family. However, the accident traumatized Gian, so Gian chose to end his life.
Salman Cooks Fried Rice

Shinta Ratri, a 57-year-old Muslim trans woman, recounts her life experiences—childhood memories, struggles of growing up, marriage—and her journey as the founder of the Islamic Boarding School of Al-Fatah in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

A story of childhood memories, love, and family.  A story where Honda plays a part in every twist and turn as a family journeys through life, where childhood friends find true love only to find that fate seems to have other plans...

A teenage girl who is not Cinderella is met with a man who brings her shoe next to it so that they can love each other, change friendship from enmity, unite families and get the most valuable value to respect her life and others.
A teenage girl with a tragic life is desperate to run away from her village to continue her education even though she has to go through the ferocity of the Papuan Jungle.
Living in a conservative family that forces her to cover up, Dhea, a teenage girl, wants to express herself through the way she dresses.

Once upon a time Rizky, 10 years old, dreamed that he was in the wilderness meeting a group of robbers who wanted to kill his school friend, Amanda. After that dream, many strange things happened to Rizky, but Rizky never realized it.
Cat Cleaning Herself

All his life Wulan, he only wanted to be a dancer. When his father, Lukman and his brother, Satria were still alive, they were the ones who always supported Wulan's ideals. But now they are dead, and Wulan lives only with her mother, Linda. Linda wants Wulan to succeed in her life, but she is worried about Wulan who likes to dance. For him dance is something serious. One day they are without an object, making Wulan go to the hills with Joko, her boyfriend who has been secretly hidden for so long. On their way home, they had a miraculous accident, leaving Wulan stranded in another world.
Discover the life of renowned Muslim scholar Buya Hamka, from his humble West Sumatra origins to his political achievements.

Sabar, Wahyu, Slamet, Sugeng and Rahayu live in Selopamioro Village, 40 km south of Yogyakarta. Five friends who live in this simplicity still have a high spirit to gain knowledge.  When the sun comes up they go to school barefoot, cross the river and walk a few kilometers, and at dusk they come to recite the Koran at the Islamic boarding school by torchlight.  At first, Sabar did not allow his grandmother to attend the Koran at the Islamic boarding school because she had to help him find firewood and grass for the goats. Patience and asking Kyai Landung to persuade grandmother, so Patience can attend the recitation.  One day, five friends accidentally found something odd in the middle of a teak forest.

Being the victim of a wrong target, Sasa dies in a car accident but her restless spirit is unaware that she is dead and returns home. Two ghosts try to help Sasa understand that she is dead and teach her how to be a new ghost. Sasa tries to save her siblings' lives when they are in danger so that she may settle all that she needs to and depart with closure.
About a painter who romanticizes the myth of a tortured artist

This is the story of a girl named London (Cheverly Amalia) who has everything in terms of career. London became a model and a top artist who came from a well-off family. However, despite having it all, London has always faced a number of problems. Candra (Gading Marten) likes London and tries to approach her by disguising himself as a gay.

A romantic drama film with Batak culture between the blind Lingga (Kinaryosih) and Bow (Alex Abbad), a photographer combined with the harmonization of hasapi (traditional Batak music) and the beauty of Lake Toba.
director: Hendra Arifin Hutapea, Ginanti Rona Tembang Asri, BM Joe

overview: Sam, the beautiful girl is guarding the supermarket 24 hours. His eyes caught a criminal trying to shoplift. Turns out he was threatening to hand over all the money in the cash register to him or he would detonate the bomb attached to him.
This story is a time travel story where some people who don't know each other go about their daily lives, and finally time also makes them meet each other.

Marisa and Dino are in one school and one class. Between them there are often quarrels over minor matters. Dino's friends are annoyed with Dino's always giving in, as well as Marisa's friends who like to give advice to Marisa, but Marisa doesn't care, Marisa is still mean to Dino.
This film tells about the life journey of several students at a campus in Bandung, namely Slamet, Fuad, Gungun, Poltak, Benny and Ria.
Oxygen Producer
If the house is left and emptied for more months or years, then don't blame it, if the occupants are supernatural beings.
This film depicts the characters of 7 orphans who are raised by a village leader known as Kyai Akhmad.
Jaka, considers himself to be the person who has the most problems in the world. Because of this pile of problems, Jaka's head hurts and gets dizzy.

Arjuna meets Sandra and Sandi, Arjuna has a star key to make Sandra and Sandi surprised. Sandra and Sandi have a map of the ancient tomb, they have a mission to save an ancient book containing a spell that can revive the dead from criminals.
Three first year junior high school teenagers lives closely in a housing complex since childhood.
Atikah, a young doctor who is sweet, sincere, cheerful, and super busy, lives happily with Mutiara, her only sister who suffers from lupus.
Badai is a marine assigned to an Indonesian border guard post on an island in the South China Sea.

The documentary presents a free jazz collaboration by Western jazz artistes Guerino Mozzola, Heinz Geisser, and Norris Jones, along with the community of Lima Gunung, the Sono Seni Ensemble, and the art community of the Boko, Prambanan and Borobudur temples. The scenes in the film are mostly taken around these three ancient temples. Drawing reference to the "jazz" of everyday life, Nugroho juxtaposes the domestic life of the village communities with the free form musical structure. In essence, free jazz parallels the lives of these communities: They adjust to the natural forces which affect their surroundings and are flexible to improvise when the need arises. Teak Leaves at the Temple is a fascinating piece of tapestry weaving together the diverse cultural influences of Indonesia. Under the masterful direction of Nugroho, this film promises yet again to deliver a breathtakingly beautiful journey into the heart of Indonesia's cultural heritage.
Euphoria tells the story of four people involved in a theatrical production titled “Srikandi”, who are on a journey to find their identity and their respective euphoria.
For three years in the capital city, Gunadi was still unemployed. Meanwhile, his father asked him to go home for Eid this year.
People who find mystic books get rich quick in graves. But there are some oddities.
Vania, a student, is an illegitimate child whose father is unknown. His mother died when he was eighteen years old.
The little Syafii Maarif struggled to survive in order to get higher education in the culture where education is considered irrelevant.
Work and appearance are two very important things in Gilang's life.
What do you really need in a girl? Handsome boyfriend? Sweet and kind older sister? Keke is not just any girl.
Tells the story of a single parent, Idayu, still young, beautiful, smart, attractive. Has two beautiful daughters Mira and Kirei.
Tells about the love and solidarity of the children of the La Tansa Islamic boarding school, namely Apoy, Faank, Tomi, and Ovie.
This sports comedy film takes place in Bolanesia, a fictional country. The story is about two soccer teams who always compete fiercely.
Libby, a female basketball player, is caught in confusion when she is faced with two boys who are quite different in age from her and who both love Libby.

Dania is a famous model and advertisement star who is always being chased by journalists. In her daily life, Dania, who is also a student, is surrounded by her four best friends, Visi, Lintang, Angel and Indira.
Zara Zettira is a famous Novelist who has lost her passion for writing long ago. He decided not to make any more Novels no matter what.

This film consists of three stories. The first story is about Ryan alias Sasak Adi, a young Sasak native who lives with his uncle (his mother died while giving birth to Ryan) in Jakarta. The second story is about Anjani, a Sasak woman who is obedient and still respects her cultural values. The third is about Wati (Aufa Asfarina Febrianggie), who lives in the same village as Anjani, talkative about following trends.

The film "Udin Cari Alamat Palsu" tells of Udin's journey around the world who received a recorded call from Mr. Fransoa, a Caucasian from France who owns a recording business and a cafe that almost went bankrupt.
A small story from the border of Tangerang Regency and Bogor Regency. It was there that Kang Sui Liong, the temple guard, lived with his wife and children.
Vivi, an executive woman, is well-established, has a career, a car, an apartment, a lover, although it's a bit difficult to meet them because they are both busy.
Pak Omat is known to be rich but stingy. When Mr. Omat was about to perform the pilgrimage, no local residents were present on the night of thanksgiving.

Above the water, the Indonesian island of Balobaloang looks like an ideal tropical paradise, with blue skies, coconut trees, and crystal water. Under the water, however, "fish bombing" with dynamite and cyanide is destroying the coral reef, threatening the marine habitat and the livelihoods of the island's inhabitants. Traditionally, people who live in small islands in Indonesia have fished using sustainable fishing methods, and conserving and sharing resources. However, a high overseas demand for fish has created a new kind of economy, in which cargo ship owners export fish at the expense of island residents. Corruption and illegal fishing practices have made it impossible for traditional fishermen to receive a fair share of their paradise.

Babe Cabita, a radio broadcaster in Medan, has a lot of fans. But Well, honey, working on a small radio so it is not growing. Fatiya, Babe's girlfriend, suggested Babe stop working on the radio and become a regular employee in his uncle's office.Despite his heavy heart, Babe follows Fatiya's advice to undergo an interview at Fatiya's uncle's office. But Babe broke his promise. Fatiya is angry and decides to leave Babe for Jakarta because he has been accepted to work in a law office. Babe who could not escape Fatiya then followed him to Jakarta and looked for him. During the search, Babe met Abdur, a friend from overseas who was trying his luck to become a comedian at the Stand Up Comedy event.
The story of the simple life of a human child in finding his identity and returning to the way of Allah SWT.
Two best friends embark on a journey to Sagarmatha (Nepalese for Mount Everest) to fulfill their dreams and promise to each other of climbing the tallest mountain in the world.
Vellya, a Balinese teenager, moves to a seaside town with his mother. The bombing in Bali caused Vellya's father to die and Vellya had hearing difficulties.

A playboy's encounter with a woman in the National Library's elevator gets complicated. His invitation to the next meeting was accepted with the riddle she gave him. The answer to the riddle is the time and place of their next meeting.
Dewo has been an addict since college. As a result of being entangled in the black world, Dewo was expelled from his campus abroad.
Adi is a high school student who is independent, intelligent, and has many friends. He was born in the village and raised by his grandfather, Sumbo.
Kartini, a solo organ singer in the village, is willing to live in the capital with her husband, an intercity bus driver. Kartini has a million hopes in Jakarta.

Egi is an individual who speaks and behaves bitterly, sloppy and rude and is caught in a drug mirage. Meanwhile, Fatimah is the daughter of the head of an Islamic boarding school who is polite, sensitive and gentle, and firmly believes that the most important thing is that God is with her in her life.

The adventures of a group of children uncovering a child trafficking ring. Five children try to escape from the criminals who kidnapped them. With their intelligence and compactness, these five children fool the kidnappers.
Mella is haunted by memories of her sister who is suspected of being autistic. The younger brother died in a car accident. Mella became close to the autistic teenagers.
Tells about treasure, love and throne. A love story between an errand boy with a deaf girl and a girl with thalassemia.
These are three stories about humans who have to live in shophouses. On the top floor of life and on the ground floor of life.
director: Sigi Wimala, Ilya Sigma, Luna Maya

overview: Unexpected luck and deadly crash. A mysterious girl, ex-killer and madman in shackles. Andreas waited for signs to call him closer, which he had been ignoring.
15 Years after reformation movement that toppled down Soeharto in 1998. Is Indonesia now better compare to New Regime time of Soeharto?
At the age of 6, Sinar had to struggle to care for her paralyzed mother alone. On the sidelines of school, he had to wash and cook, because he came from a poor family.
One hundred years ago, in a descendant Chinese village, the territory of the Dutch East Indies. Once upon a time, three "Amoy" whose actions were famous throughout the country.

Each of us has our own story. Tara also has a past that she can't describe. Putting memories of a man he calls father. What is Tara's love and hatred for her father like? What about Rizky's presence who is able to make Tara's life more colorful?

The pandemic isn't over yet. Many countries have re-implemented lockdowns, even countries big talk will go to the moon. A boy named Zeldi really wanted to go to month. One time his unemployed father discovered a program to move to the moon but turned out to be too expensive. Zeldi found a way for them to pay the cost.
A father who was arrested for allegedly being the perpetrator of land burning, and his son, is an Indonesian National Army (TNI) who regretted his father's actions of burning forests and land.
In 2030, Sisca, a teenage girl who was enjoying a television program, accidentally came across an advertisement commercialising the figure of a mother at home, namely Robot Mom.

Dara, the actress who returned for her latest horror film 'Boneka Arwah' after her divorce from her husband Darius had put an end to her career. One day, their son, Embun died and both of them felt sad. The two of them together with Jenny, Dara's assistant, finally found a way out until Embun appeared through Dara's own new doll property.

Young marriage never crossed Arga's mind, Arga don't know what his parents were thinking of, until he was able to marry himself to the son of his father's best friend. Or as a will that must be fulfilled when Arga is eighteen years old.

Melani, who is pregnant, went to find her husband at the Karet plantation because his husband had not come home for 2 months. There he met and experienced various strange events that happened to him which made him wonder, what happened in this place?

Not willing to let the woman he loves be matched with someone else, Bagas promised Ajeng and her family of blue blood descendants to be successful people and could become people who deserve Ajeng in the eyes of her family.
One night, a woman, who was calming a baby in her lap, was visited by a scary creature commonly called Kuyang or Tuju, and the unexpected happened.

Sekaten is a short documentary exploring one of Javas most cosmic festivals. The old world and the new are colliding and creating interesting images and sounds. Sekaten is a popular festival marking the birth of the Islamic prophet Mohammed and is the only week of the year when the mystical Gamelan Sekaten music is performed.
A girl who is good at playing the piano falls in love with a boy named Genta. He wanted to express his feelings, but the boy disappeared along with the function of the girl's two eyes.

Ngaben: Emotion and Restraint in a Balinese Heart takes an impressionistic look at the ngaben from the perspective of a mourning son, Nyoman Asub, and reveals the intimacy, sadness, and tenderness at the core of this funerary ritual and the feeling and force that underlie an exquisite cultural tradition. Amidst ample cultural and interpretive understandings of the cremation ceremony, the film purposefully provides a personalistic, impressionistic, and poetic glimpse of the process and the complex emotions involved.

The disappearance of Riani's doll makes Riana come to Elodia's dormitory. The dormitory is often carried out by female students, who perform ritual games using a mirror, namely Bloody Mary. However, this game revolves around the terror that harms Elodia's students. Riani's innocent doll is the mastermind. Riana, who is unraveling the mystery, is trapped in the middle of a condition to bring Riani home and find the answer to the innocent terror of her favorite doll.
Two best friends who create ASMR content together discover a world of personal exploration that leads them both toward harrowing outcomes.
A street sweeper, The messenger of the red-blooded letter to the soldier found out it was abused. Responsible for the extermination of neutralists during the Gestok/Gestapu era in Bali.
One night, Intan visits Sekala Jewelry Store to make her wedding ring. There, she meets Kala, a mysterious jeweler who seems very familiar to Intan. How will fate lead them?

Somad is a young religious man who is looking for a job as a religious teacher in Jakarta. After few months he hasn't got the job yet, which eats away at his savings. When Somad has breakfast in a food stall with the little money he has left, Sari, a transwoman who has just finished her 'night job', comes into the same food stall.

Ceti is a woman from Bogor who is experiencing financial difficulties during the COVID-19 pandemic. Her clothing kiosk in Bogor Market was forced to close. Her husband, who works as an online loan debt collector, cannot collect debts from people who had lost their jobs, and her son asks for a smartphone to go to online school. Inadvertently, she finds a solution to her problems when she collects a debt from the family of someone who recently died.
Three office workers were terrorized by the sudden sound of gamelan in their office. Uneasy, they approach the source of the sound and have to deal with something.
While taking care of his beloved pet bird named Jambu, Attal must face his older brother who keeps on taking away his money.

Newly married Jordan and Dewina has to face tragic fate. The night Jordan who should enjoy the first night, suddenly abandoned by Dewina who goes to discos just to vent his passion.  Accompanied by her friend Riska, Dewina spend the night at discotheque and drunk. At that moment comes Rico, who likes Dewina, along with three companions, Sandy, Gerry, and Dion. Rico fed Dewina with drugs until unconscious.  Rico cs then rape Dewina. Panic attack happens when they realize Dewina lifeless. Rico decides to throw Dewina so that no one knows.

Darsono, the son of a poor farmer, fights against many difficulties and challenges to reach his dream. His father does not understand the importance of education. Even so this barrier never diminish the hope of his future and dreams he builds together with Jamhari, his best friend since childhood, who always support him. His friendship with Jamhari and the struggle to tackle the poverty, social conflicts in society, and his affair with Ika become a unity of signs in his symphony of life.

What could you do with two thousand rupiah? In this journey a bill of two thousand rupiah will walk you through humans' life full of diversity in way of thinking. The two thousand rupiah bill will explain and observe the money-engaging activities of human life especially with thousand rupiah bill, just like a documentary resource person do. A bill of two thousand rupiah sarcasticly notes comment on humans who use it.
A Youtubers couple who specialize in prank content, got terror while preparing for their first child's baby shower.
Two bored mans talking about an interesting topic while everyone is condolences for a family who mourns the death of a loved one.
A tattooist who doesn't believe in falling in love with a flower shop owner who is not happy with his marriage.
Life is like clouds, it comes and goes, sometimes it's dark, sometimes it's bright. Sometimes it looks lonely alone, but sometimes it also comes in droves. Change from one form to another.
A Sequel to "Cinta di Balik Awan" movie.
The trilogy and also the final act of Umay Shahab's trilogy.
To please his parents, Dika hides his true self by dancing it out.

Religion, Disputes, harassment, chaos, massacres, wars, terrorism and many problems often occur in the name of religion. In 2035 Indonesia is divided into two, the eastern part which still adheres to religion and the western part which removes religion. Religious activities are considered illegal and immoral in the west. Religion disappeared in no time. It all looks fine. But people's morals and hearts are broken and damaged because they rely on themselves to live. Among the people who begin to forget God, there are still those who fight for their religion which is called UNDERGROUND. This is their story.  This film was made as a religious lesson for Rayner and his friends in high school, 7 years ago.

After Cokrokusumo's death, Uma tries to deal with the trauma while looking for answers to the mystery of the Kuntilanak's involvement in her life. Meanwhile, Brotoseno, Nyi Kenanga and Karmila are taking heinous methods to bring Mangkujiwo to the pinnacle of glory, where blood will again be spilled.
Layaria presents a horror film that tells the story of a house inhabited by spirits. The exorcists tried to chase them away, did it work?

After the events of September 30, 1965, a village in Bantul was frequently visited by flying saucers. While walking in a sugarcane field after seeing a flying saucer, an elementary school boy meets a small dinosaur. The incident was the beginning of the appearance of other dinosaurs in the village.

On Digi’s birthday, an unemployed Father prepares all the ingredients to make Digi’s favorite food, noodles. With an online video tutorial, Father cooked noodles with the help of Digi. At night, Mom brings a birthday gift in the form of spaghetti for Digi which causes the noodle not to be eaten.

Ting! Guntur received a notification from his new smartphone. Siti, his wife, also received the same message. They’re just invited to their high school alumni group chat. At first, they seem unfamiliar with this new thing, but at the same time they’re excited to see every news that was shared in the group. But someone new just invited to the group and disturb this joyful occurrence, Siti’s ex-boyfriend.
